part.text:
Saved to `recommendations.json`.

| Stage | Level | Recommendation |
|---|---:|---|
| prototype | 4 | Vibe-code freely; keep secrets and real data out of prompts. |
| proof-of-concept | 3 | Selectively review risky paths and verify the demo. |
| mvp | 3 | Review risky changes and test behavior; line-by-line for sensitive flows. |
| production | 2 | Review every AI-generated change line by line before release. |
| critical | 1 | AI may suggest, but humans author/rewrite every line; use 0 if regulations prohibit AI-generated code. |

The overall principle: maximize AI autonomy for disposable work, then steadily increase human review as code gains users, revenue, and regulatory obligations.
